stories.headline: PSD sets April 20 internal referendum on withdrawing support from PM Bolojan, triggering coalition crisis
stories.summary: PSD launched an internal vote branded 'Momentul Adevărului' scheduled for April 20 to decide whether to withdraw political support from Liberal PM Ilie Bolojan. PSD leader Sorin Grindeanu, former PM Ciolacu, and multiple PSD figures publicly demanded Bolojan's resignation, citing economic austerity; Bolojan refused, PNL and USR defended the government, and financial markets flagged rising borrowing costs tied to political uncertainty.

stories.headline: George Simion meets Călin Georgescu, appears at PSD hotel in Timișoara amid coalition crisis

stories.headline: Nicușor Dan's presidency draws NGO criticism and PNL pressure amid coalition crisis
stories.summary: Twenty-five NGOs published an open letter to President Nicușor Dan accusing him of following Iohannis-era practices and failing reform commitments, particularly around prosecutor general appointments; simultaneously, PNL deputies warned Dan he risked political collapse if he failed to firmly back PM Bolojan, while commentators debated whether he would be 'Iohannis 2.0'.

stories.headline: Former PM Ciolacu admits Romania knowingly delayed Pfizer vaccine lawsuit, sparking political blame game
stories.summary: Marcel Ciolacu publicly acknowledged at an April 15 press conference that the Romanian government had known since 2023 it would likely lose a Pfizer COVID vaccine lawsuit (Romania faces ~€600 million in payments) but deliberately stalled proceedings; former Health Minister Mihăilă hit back, and ex-minister Rafila also entered the dispute, with multiple parties trading blame over the original 2021 vaccine contracts.

stories.headline: Vlad Voiculescu accuses Iohannis and Cîțu of falsifying COVID death statistics ahead of 2020 elections
stories.summary: Former Health Minister Vlad Voiculescu made explosive allegations on the five-year anniversary of his dismissal, claiming the Iohannis-Cîțu government manipulated COVID death data at the INSP to enable December 2020 elections, resulting in thousands of uncounted deaths; the claim drew immediate commentary but no institutional response in the coverage window.

stories.headline: Russian drone violates Romanian airspace near Chilia Veche during Ukraine strike
stories.summary: During the night of April 16–17, a Russian drone entered Romanian airspace near the Danube Delta border, disappearing from radar approximately 16 km from Chilia Veche in an uninhabited area; the Romanian Ministry of Defense condemned the incursion as a threat to regional security and deployed search teams, while air policing services had already been activated days earlier.

stories.headline: Energy Minister Bogdan Ivan announces €3.5 billion in US-backed energy investments and Lukoil sanctions derogation
stories.summary: Minister of Energy Bogdan Ivan, following a Washington trip, announced US EXIM Bank financing for strategic energy projects, a $500 million gas infrastructure investment, and confirmed a US government derogation from Lukoil sanctions enabling restart of the Petrotel-Lukoil refinery; separately, Border Police denied he received preferential treatment at border crossing.

stories.headline: EU opens in-depth state aid investigation into Romania's Cernavoda Unit 1 nuclear refurbishment
stories.summary: The European Commission announced on April 16 it had opened an in-depth investigation into Romania's planned state aid for the refurbishment of Cernavoda nuclear plant Unit 1 (706 MW), which Romania notified to Brussels in January 2026, to assess compliance with EU state aid rules.

articles.title: EU opens in-depth investigation into Romanian state aid for Cernavoda 1 nuclear reactor

stories.headline: BNR publishes Eurozone Monitor: Romania unready for euro, external debt rises to €230 billion
stories.summary: The National Bank of Romania published its Eurozone Monitor report during the week concluding that Romania cannot adopt the euro without sustained fiscal discipline (budget deficit below 3% of GDP) and low inflation, comparing unfavorably to Bulgaria; separately BNR data showed Romania's total external debt grew €1.5 billion in January-February to €229.96 billion.

stories.headline: Romania leads EU measles cases as vaccination rates collapse to 20% in some communities
stories.summary: The Guardian reported that Romania recorded over 35,000 measles cases and at least 30 deaths between 2023–2025, accounting for approximately 87% of all EU cases, with second-dose MMR uptake at only 60% nationally and as low as 20% in some communities, raising warnings from doctors of another imminent outbreak.
